samples.xml_description:
<module id="pulse_detect">
    <description>Detects rising edges in data_in, producing one pulse in data_out per detected rise.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Reset signal (active low).</input>
        <input id="data_in">One-bit input signal.</input>
        <output id="data_out">Output signal indicating the presence of pulses.</output>
    </ports>
    <implementation>
        Detects rising edges in data_in, producing one pulse in data_out per detected rise.
        
        Example:
            Input: data_in = 01010
            Output: data_out = 00101
    </implementation>
    
</module>
